question: How many Books of the Dead has Mr. Ezzo read through in total?
answer:
At the current point, twelve. I don't think the number has increased beyond that.

Ezzo himself understands that the more he reads, the more dangerous it becomes, and I think he knows he needs to stop somewhere. But I feel like he's going, “I'll stop at 20... I'll stop at 25... I'll stop at 30... Phew, 100.” So we should probably get him out of the library as soon as possible. (laughs)
